latestVersion.changelog:
AI Image to Video skill, initial release:

- Instantly turns up to three uploaded JPG product photos into 1080p AI-animated video clips based on quick text prompts.
- Fully cloud-based setup: automatic free token generation, session management, and rapid connection; no installation required.
- Supports uploads, AI-driven editing (aspect ratio, overlays, BGM, etc.), and fast MP4 export, all using simple chat instructions.
- Clear error handling for common upload, credit, and export issues.
- Provides on-the-fly session updates, visual timeline summaries, and handles edit events via live stream for a seamless user experience.
- Supports a range of formats for both input and output (mp4, jpg, png, gif, webm, wav, etc.).
